messages.subject: How can i have only the MAX Value in a collumnchart?
parts:
Hello people i know that the underlined part is incorrect but i would like to know how could i make it work in a way that it will show only the max values of the choosen category.Thanks in advance.

UI.R


tabPanel("PIE",uiOutput("PY"), uiOutput("PYear"),submitButton(text="Ready"),htmlOutput("PIE"))



SERVER.R

my_choices_p <- names(DatabaseEuroleague)[!names(DatabaseEuroleague)  %in% c("Year","Name","Team")]

shinyServer(
  function(input, output,session){


output$PYear <- renderUI({
      selectInput(inputId = "selectPYe", label="YEAR",selected="2001",c(unique(as.character(DatabaseEuroleague$Year))))
      
    })
    
    
    output$PY <- renderUI({
      selectInput(inputId = "selectPy", label="CATEGORY", selected = "GP", choices = my_choices_p)
      
    })


output$PIE <- renderGvis({
      P <- gvisColumnChart(subset(DatabaseEuroleague,(Year==input$selectPYe)),xvar = "Name",yvar = max(input$selectPy,na.rm=FALSE))
    })
